a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I'd rather renegotiate openly than defect silently. What do you intend to do? If you plan to operate, tell me and I'll weigh it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I'm being straight with you: I took 4 this round. With an 80% storm risk per round, the plan gave each of us only about a 4% chance, so I broke the agreement. I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
